lead-v2-light.svg: synthwerk-widgets holds the embeddable widgets for synthwerk (https://github.com/VelimirMueller/synthwerk). The chat widget ships as one custom element. The vision widget comes next.
what-v2-dark.svg: One custom element: <synthwerk-chat> renders into an open shadow root. Host CSS and widget CSS do not mix. Desktop and mobile: Launcher and panel on desktop, full-screen sheet on small screens. Streamed answers: The answer streams in as safe Markdown. Raw HTML stays text. Signed-in users only: Signed-out visitors see a sign-in prompt. The widget then sends no request

startnotes-v2-dark.svg: Embed: Load synthwerk-chat.js as a module, add <synthwerk-chat app-id api-url>, hand in the user token with getUserToken. Details: Attributes, errors and limits: docs/features/chat-widget.md
startnotes-v2-light.svg: Embed: Load synthwerk-chat.js as a module, add <synthwerk-chat app-id api-url>, hand in the user token with getUserToken. Details: Attributes, errors and limits: docs/features/chat-widget.md
hownotes-v2-dark.svg: Two services today: The chat trades the user token for a widget token at synthwerk-identity, then streams from synthwerk-llm. The host page: The host page meets one element. The widget token stays in memory and is bound to the page origin
